text: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
author: Nelson Mandela

text: The function of education is to teach one to think intensively and to think critically.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

text: A child educated only at school is an uneducated child.
author: George Santayana

text: Tell me and I forget. Teach me and I remember. Involve me and I learn.
author: Benjamin Franklin

text: The teacher who is indeed wise does not bid you to enter the house of their wisdom but leads you to the threshold of your mind.
author: Khalil Gibran

text: If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
author: African proverb

text: It takes a whole village to raise a child.
author: African proverb

text: Knowledge is like a baobab tree; no one person can embrace it alone.
author: African proverb

text: Sankofa — go back and fetch it.
author: Adinkra
meaning: It is not wrong to go back for that which you have forgotten; learning builds on what came before.

author: Adinkra
meaning: Wisdom, ingenuity and patience are needed to achieve a goal.

author: Adinkra
meaning: They share one stomach yet fight over food; unity in diversity matters more than difference.

text: The beautiful thing about learning is that no one can take it away from you.
author: B.B. King
